name: Nonohara Hime
source: Hime is the poster girl for her family's long established 'Nonohara Tofu Shop', and has served to help her father run the store and raise her younger siblings ever since her mother passed away. She is admired for her sweet and delicate features, though she doesn't like nor consider herself to be cute at all.
